checks.compatibility: Final follow-up only rejects nonpositive initial stops in the opt-in guard path, covered by focused_final; legacy path tested here unchanged.

checks.access: read-only config/files/stat; no bridge connection, database open, native process or lease

checks.change: StrategyInfo uses the existing H suggested M5/M15/H1 labels only; no qualification or signal/execution change.

contracts.target_precedence: Explicit fill-anchored target_points/target_r overrides strategy signal-close target; explicit fixed stop overrides initial EMA offset only.
contracts.ema_anchor: first close of fixed input frame; invalid OHLC blocks the remaining prefix; no silent restart

coverage: independent Decimal ratio-of-sums K, SMA D and first-close-seeded EMA
prefix causality and unchanged historical signals
warmup300/305, strict current thresholds and previous equality
HLC windows and OHLC EMA prefix: NaN, positive/negative infinity, EMPTY_VALUE, overflow, flat range and window recovery
real Backtester long/short, point/tick/offset/risk/lot, no retroactive SL touch
guard zero-offset enabled vs explicit off, monotonicity, equal/invalid/wrong-side rejection, BID/ASK
ATR and confirmed partial/BE cannot be loosened; TP and volume preserved
signal-close TP vs fill gap and existing fill/R overrides in real BaseAdapter
composition registry units, JSON roundtrip and materialized trade levels

limits.cache_reason: Existing run_python identity gate rejects extra instance state min_bars; no gate changes or historical cache waiver.

setup: Own venv; prepared dependency packages read via local .pth, pip requirements-dev satisfied; no shared venv mutation or global installer/shortcut rewrite.
